in_sanskrit.name: द्हीव्यंश

in_marathi.name: Dheevyansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheevyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheevyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Dhee’ meaning God and ‘Vansh’ meaning Abode or Lineage. This name signifies the divine dwelling place of the Gods, and is often given to children born into pious families, as a reminder of their divine connection and duty to uphold the virtues and values of their lineage.
